title: Truncate
summary: Shorten text to at most limit characters (Unicode code points; limit is never negative). Text that fits comes back unchanged. Longer text keeps its first limit - 1 characters followed by "…" (U+2026), which counts as one character.
hints: Count the text in code points first. Your language's length may count bytes or UTF-16 code units instead.
Cut by code point too: slicing by bytes can split a character in half (or panic), and slicing UTF-16 units can split an emoji.
Handle the small cases on their own: a limit of 0 leaves no room at all, and a limit of 1 leaves room only for the "…".

cases.description: a limit of one leaves only the ellipsis
cut right after an accented letter
an emoji counts as one character
a combining accent counts on its own
